_golden: GOLDEN REFERENCE (arc reveal: consumer electronics, hardware, mobility, industrial). Study it, then write YOUR product's film from YOUR docs. Do not copy its lines, its numbers or its product. It is not buildable (no materials). Every _why says what a top crew did and why.
_facts: The docs this film was written from (fictional product): Halden H1 desk lamp. The colour temperature follows the time of day, from 6500 K at noon to 2700 K after sunset. CRI 97 LED. One machined aluminium dial for brightness; no app needed. 9 W. Arm and base turned from one aluminium bar in Bergen. Two finishes: raw aluminium and graphite.

_anchors.proposition: Your desk light should follow the day outside, not fight it.
_anchors.concept: Four o'clock — the hour daylight turns warm, and the lamp turns with it
_anchors.hook: At four o'clock, the light outside turns warm.
_anchors.hero: Halden. Light that keeps the time.
_anchors._why: The concept is one ordinary, true moment (an hour of the day) instead of a list of specs. The hook names the moment, the hero line names the product's part in it, the last line returns to the moment.

brand.name: Halden
brand.positioningEn: A DESK LAMP THAT FOLLOWS THE DAY

scenes._why: The whole cover is a cold open: no logo, no name; the brand lands at the hero and the end card. Detail before the whole: the cover is the warm afternoon light on a desk, not the lamp. The line is a true observation the audience recognises.

say.en: At four o'clock, the light outside turns warm.
say.zh: 下午四点，窗外的光开始变暖。

scenes._why: The tease: the knurled dial in macro, no voice, but each crop is labelled, so the silence has a purpose. Texture makes the viewer lean in before the reveal.
The reveal line names the product and its one behaviour. Nothing else. The cut-out stands on the stage; the light does the work.
The proof is the range in kelvin, said as what you see (noon white → evening amber). Numbers on screen, words in the voice.

say.en: Clear white at noon. Amber after sunset. It changes on its own.
say.zh: 正午清白，日落后琥珀色；它自己会变。

scenes._why: Craft + origin, one fact with a place in it, and a different shape from the card before it: the machining photo full-bleed with one title. Places and materials are concrete; 'premium build' is not.
